title: Automated Standardization of Legacy Biomedical Metadata Using an Ontology-Constrained LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2604.08552v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Descriptive scientific metadata in public repositories are often incomplete and inconsistent with community standards and ontologies, limiting data FAIRness. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising approach to automatically standardizing such metadata when provided with relevant standards in machine-actionable form, such as metadata templates from the CEDAR Workbench. Prompt engineering, however, provides only fixed snapshots of these standards and relies on an LLM's pretrained knowledge to interpret and satisfy their constraints. We evaluate whether giving an LLM access to metadata specifications and authoritative terminology at runtime improves automated metadata standardization. Methods: We present ARMS, a tool-augmented LLM agent that retrieves complete CEDAR metadata templates and dynamically queries authoritative biomedical terminology services at execution time. We compared ARMS with a prompt-based approach on 839

translated_title: 使用本体约束的大语言模型智能体实现遗留生物医学元数据的自动化标准化
translated_abstract: 公共存储库中的描述性科学元数据往往不完整，且与社区标准和本体不一致，从而限制了数据的FAIR性。当以机器可操作的形式（例如来自CEDAR Workbench的元数据模板）提供相关标准时，大语言模型（LLM）为自动标准化此类元数据提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，提示工程只能提供这些标准的固定快照，并且依赖LLM的预训练知识来解释和满足其约束。我们评估了在运行时让LLM访问元数据规范和权威术语是否能改善元数据的自动化标准化。方法：我们提出了ARMS，这是一个工具增强的LLM智能体，它能够检索完整的CEDAR元数据模板，并在执行时动态查询权威的生物医学术语服务。我们在839个（样本上）将ARMS与基于提示的方法进行了比较
tldr: 本文提出ARMS——一种工具增强的LLM智能体，通过在运行时检索完整的CEDAR元数据模板并动态查询权威生物医学术语服务，克服了提示工程只能使用固定标准快照的局限，显著提升了遗留生物医学元数据自动标准化的效果。
en_tdlr: ARMS, a tool-augmented LLM agent that retrieves complete CEDAR metadata templates and dynamically queries authoritative biomedical terminology services at runtime, improves automated standardization of legacy biomedical metadata compared to static prompt-based approaches.
